data.name: Parveenah
data.gender_notes: Parveenah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who lives in a beautiful and lush green meadow or garden. The name Parveenah carries the meaning “Meadow, Garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Parveenah usually hope their child will grow to embody meadow, garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a person who embodies the beauty and grace of nature, and is a source of inspiration and peace
data.etymology: Parveenah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Meadow, Garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parveenah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: بارفيانة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني كوكب أو نجم في السماء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم بارفيانة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ب-ر-ف' والذي يرتبط بمعنى كوكب أو نجم في السماء، ويعبر عن الجمال والروعة، وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية ذات الصلة بالنجوم والكواكب.

in_urdu.name: پروینہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: پروینہ کا نام عربی جڑ 'ب-ر-ف' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کوکب یا تارا، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں خوبصورت اور شاندار معنی کے حامل کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر ستاروں اور چاند کی خوبصورتی کا اظہار کرتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: पर्वीनाह
in_hindi.long_meaning: पर्वीनाह नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'ब-र-फ' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है तारा या नक्षत्र, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में सौंदर्य और दिव्यता के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है, जो अक्सर सितारों की रोशनी और चमक से जुड़ा होता है.

in_pashto.name: پروینه
in_pashto.long_meaning: پروینه نوم د عربي ريښې 'ب-ر-ف' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د کوکب يا ستوری معنی لري، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې د ښکلا او عظمت د څرګندنې په توګه کارول کیږي، په ځانګړي ډول د ستورې او اسماني پديده ګانو پورې اړوند.

in_english.name: Parveenah
in_english.long_meaning: Parveenah originates from the Arabic root 'b-r-f', signifying a star or celestial body, reflecting beauty and brilliance, mentioned in some Quranic interpretations related to stars and celestial phenomena, symbolizing divine guidance and light.

data.cultural_impact: The name Parveenah carries a deep-rooted connection to nature and can evoke feelings of tranquility and peace. In Islamic culture, gardens and greenery are often seen as symbols of paradise and the beauty of God's creations. A Parveenah, therefore, embodies these ideals and may be seen as a representation of the beauty and serenity available in the natural world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Parveenah also holds great spiritual significance, as it is derived from the Persian word "parv" meaning "lofty" and "veh" meaning "house" or "abode." Thus, Parveenah can be interpreted as a dweller in a lofty or exalted abode. In the context of spiritual growth, this could refer to a person who strives for a higher understanding of God and seeks to live a virtuous life filled with divine inspiration and grace. Therefore, Parveenah is not just a beautiful name, but a reminder of the potential for inner growth and connection to the divine.
